parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly asks the authors to "clearly define what verification means in this context." This is a direct action, and it is concrete because the authors know which claim (the second contribution bullet) needs revision and what modification (a clear definition of verification) is required. The criteria require only that the comment clearly states the action authors should take; the comment itself does not need to supply the definition's content. Here the requested action—defining verification in context—is unambiguous and directly applicable. The authors know exactly what they need to do: revise the second contribution bullet to include a clear definition of verification in this context, so there is no lack of actionable guidance.
